name: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S25
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S25 is a standard Samsung Galaxy S25 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs One UI 8.5 (Android 16) or later.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area. Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (per Atexxo).

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
